concerns.text: T009a (checksum) is marked Complete but depends on T009c (gold standard generation) which is Pending. A checksum cannot exist for a file that has not been generated. T009c must precede T009a.

T009 (Test for US1) is marked Complete but explicitly depends on T010a/T010b (schemas) and T011 (service) which are Pending. The task description admits it 'will fail until T010/T011 are complete', violating the 'Producer before consumer' rule for test execution.

T019 (Regeneration loop) is marked Complete but depends on T020 (probes.jsonl writer) and T021 (error handling) which are Pending. The logic to 'proceed if >= 50 valid probes' cannot be implemented without the writer (T020) and error handler (T021) being present first.

T026a (Aggregate scores) depends on T032 (results.jsonl writer), T025 (Judge), T026 (Rule-based), and T028 (Experiment runner). T032 is Pending. Aggregation cannot occur before the raw results file is created.
T030 (Shapiro-Wilk) depends on T032 (results.jsonl) which is Pending. T031 and T033 depend on T030. The entire statistical analysis chain is blocked by the missing results writer.
T027 (Judge Calibration) depends on T009c (human_annotations.json) which is Pending. Calibration cannot run without the gold standard data.

T025b (Rule-based metric) is marked Complete, but T026 (Rule-based scoring with sentiment) is Pending. FR-004 and US-3 require a composite score. T025b alone is insufficient for the final metric, creating a partial implementation state that blocks T026a.
